axes.model_access: The Doubao model series is disclosed via ByteDance's official release line (the official-site news page has model-iteration records); the specific model tier routing inside the consumer app is not verified item by item; enterprise-grade model interfaces are provided on a separate line via Volcengine's "Volcengine Ark".
axes.runtime: Web (doubao.com), mobile app and PC client — three lines covered; generation is processed on ByteDance's cloud, no model runs locally. Features are largely aligned across the three lines; voice chat is most convenient on mobile.
axes.local_files: Supports document parsing, text-to-image and voice chat; uploaded content is stored in the account, the training switch path is in the permissions dimension.
axes.background: Chats return instantly with no offline task queue; no official statement of an "offline continuation" form — the chat product itself does not carry long tasks; long-document processing also completes within the session.
axes.tools: In-product capability lines incl. text-to-image, voice chat and document parsing; enterprise-grade capabilities are provided on the separate Volcengine Ark API line.
axes.context: Chat history is organized per session and syncs across devices when signed in; the cross-session memory mechanism is not verified item by item (no official docs verified for a standalone memory-management entry — if unknown, say unknown).
axes.permissions: Official privacy policy §1.10: on the premise of "processing with secure encryption, strict de-identification such that specific individuals cannot be re-identified", input data, prompts and generated replies may be used for model training; you can turn it off via "Settings → Privacy & Permissions → Help improve the model" (mobile) or "Settings → Help improve the model" (PC/web). The API line has a different term: Volcengine's Doubao Model Service Agreement §4.1 — unless you separately consent, content you submit or output is not used to train the foundation models.
axes.fit: Chinese everyday Q&A and text-to-image. The App training switch is self-service and the API does not train by default — the two lines' terms differ, don't blend them. For running models locally or swapping models freely, it is not suitable.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to chat products).
